messages:
Alex S.: Quick question — EMEA enterprise wants a 6mo on-prem POC (VPC) and is pushing back on the standard platform fee + premium support. Can we do a temporary discount or waiver for the POC?
Jordan (SE): What does the POC look like? concurrent sessions, GPUs, data residency? that drives cost.
Alex S.: They want a single VPC deployment, up to 8 GPU workers, low-latency routing. No long-term commit yet, they want to evaluate for 6 months.
Priya K.: Typical approach: either 1) short-term pilot waiver of platform fee with onboarding PS fee, or 2) reduced platform fee for pilot if they provide a revenue/usage commit (12mo). Which is this deal leaning to?
Alex S.: Customer prefers no commit upfront. asking for full waiver for 6mo. also expects enterprise support (24/7) during POC.
Sam - DealDesk: Waiving the platform fee for 6mo is a big ask. Options: 
- Waive platform fee for 3 months, then reduced fee months 4-6
- Full 6mo waiver if they sign a 12mo financial commit (min ARR) 
We need a paper trail with projected usage and expected ARR to run numbers.
Ben (Legal): If we change standard terms we need an amendment. Also need to confirm liability/SLA language for a POC. If they want premium support we need to map the SLA to the limited-duration env.
Jordan (SE): Technical blockers to note: KMS/HSM integration, audit logging retention, and network setup for VPC. If Legal/Customer require HSM we may need additional setup time.
Alex S.: Customer sent security checklist — they're requesting SOC2 evidence, KMS support, on-prem key management, and penetration test report. Can we deliver those during a POC?
Priya K.: SOC2 and pen-test artifacts are static — we can share redacted reports. KMS/HSM is typically available but HSM-backed keys may need Private deployment entitlements (extra SKU). That's where platform fee helps cover ops.
Sam - DealDesk: Practical rate-card levers: platform-fee waiver, support-tier discount, PS onboarding credits. We can approve a pilot concession up to 50% platform fee discount for deals under $X ARR with manager signoff. Anything beyond that goes to revenue ops.
Ben (Legal): Also flag export controls and EU data residency clauses. If this is on-prem in EU, that's normal but legal needs the deployment address for contract.
Jordan (SE): Deploy-bot: provision request queued for sandbox cluster.
deploy-bot: Job #9831 created: provision-poc-vpc (8 gpus). ETA ~48h. Logs: https://ci.internal/provision/9831
Alex S.: Thanks — team, can we align on an approved path we can offer the customer today so sales can move? I want to avoid back-and-forth.
Priya K.: Proposal to offer: 3mo platform-fee waiver + onboarding PS (reduced) + trial support (business hours) for pilot. If they convert to 12mo commit within pilot, grandfather in premium support and full platform discounts on signature. This is low-risk.
Sam - DealDesk: I can approve that with standard caveats. I'll need: projected monthly token/host usage, customer's legal billing entity, and expected signature timeline. I'll add the concession to the deal and route for manager approval.
Ben (Legal): I can prep an amendment template for the 3mo waiver + conversion clause. Send me the customer name and deployment address.
Jordan (SE): I'll confirm KMS/HSM readiness and ETA. If HSM required, note extra 5 business days.
Alex S.: I'll collect the usage projections and customer entity today. Ping @Sam - DealDesk when I have numbers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sam - DealDesk: 👍 will stand by.
Priya K.: I'll note the support-tier change in the rate card comment.
Ben (Legal): I'll draft amendment and share for review.
Alex S.: Closing loop — customer is OK with 3mo pilot waiver if we keep the conversion pathway. Moving to commit next steps.
deploy-bot: Job #9831 completed: cluster ready. IPs: 10.42.8.12, 10.42.8.13
Jordan (SE): I'll start onboarding tomorrow — plan: config, KMS smoke test, perf baseline.
Alex S.: Perfect. I'll update the customer and request signature cadence.
Sam - DealDesk: Please upload the usage projection and target signature date to the deal doc. I need it to finalize manager sign-off.
Alex S.: Will do by EOD.
Priya K.: Adding note: if pilot usage > expected baseline, we reserve right to revert to standard platform fee mid-pilot with 7-day notice. (lets be explicit).
Alex S.: Agreed, add that to amendment.
Ben (Legal): Noted. I'll include a short notice clause.
Alex S.: Thanks team — will report back once customer confirms.
